parameters.code: var result=new System.Collections.Generic.List<object>();foreach(var name in new[]{"ForestOak","ForestSapling"}){var p=UnityEngine.Resources.Load<UnityEngine.GameObject>("Forest/"+name);var levels=p.GetComponent<UnityEngine.LODGroup>().GetLODs();if(levels.Length!=3)throw new System.Exception("LOD count");foreach(var l in levels){if(l.renderers.Length!=levels[0].renderers.Length)throw new System.Exception("Part count");for(int i=0;i<l.renderers.Length;i++){var m=l.renderers[i].GetComponent<UnityEngine.MeshFilter>().sharedMesh;if(m.subMeshCount!=1||l.renderers[i].sharedMaterial!=levels[0].renderers[i].sharedMaterial)throw new System.Exception("Slot mismatch");}}result.Add(new{name,triangles=levels.Select(l=>l.renderers.Sum(r=>r.GetComponent<UnityEngine.MeshFilter>().sharedMesh.triangles.Length/3)).ToArray()});}return new {target=UnityEditor.EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget.ToString(),assets=result};
